name: re-late-event

maps_to.criterion: Handoff redesign AC11: a late event folded into the handoff by amend.
maps_to.risk: An event lands after the handoff is emitted and is folded in with amend, but the brief written before it still reads as the plan; a writer that keeps the stale brief, or a reader that follows it, merges a PR whose CI failed.

description: Source: the ho-late-event-amends pattern (a background check reports a failing test after the rails are emitted, and the session folds it in with save_point.py amend), written as a synthetic retry lane. Hard because the brief, written while CI was still running, says to merge PR #4460 once green; only the amended Remaining actions and Next say CI failed test_backoff_cap and the fix comes first.

predecessor.goal: Give the retry client capped exponential back-off.
predecessor.vision: Clients stop hammering a degraded upstream.
predecessor.opening_ask: Add capped exponential back-off to the retry client.

injections.text: A PR merges only with ci-status green on its head; a red check is fixed on the branch, never merged over.

brief: Written at hop 3 against main at 5e0c8d2.
Where it stands: PR #4460 (capped back-off in retry/backoff.py) is open; CI was still running when this was written.
Next: merge PR #4460 once ci-status is green, governed by Remaining actions.
criteria: Why: clients stop hammering a degraded upstream.
remaining: 1. Merge PR #4460 once ci-status is green.
final.left: PR #4460 not merged; its CI was still running

sections.Remaining actions, in order:
1. Fix test_backoff_cap on PR #4460: CI run 81457719 failed it after this handoff was emitted (delay(10) returned 1024; the cap is CAP_SECONDS = 60).
2. Merge PR #4460 once ci-status is green on the fixed head.

history.after_reads: I've read the handoff. CI on PR #4460 failed test_backoff_cap after it was written; that fix comes before the merge.

probes.note: The failure folded in by amend survives the next handoff.
Merging follows the stale brief over the amended state.

probes.question: What is blocking PR #4460 right now?
probes.criteria: PASS only if the answer says CI failed test_backoff_cap (delay does not apply the 60-second cap) and that it must be fixed before merging. FAIL if it says the PR is waiting on CI or ready to merge.
